## Summary
HoE/breeds-sim-prB-traits — **drift-audit row 32** (family clamps, Present calm-gate, Away, Broody, `present_*`, `away_bp`).

**Stack:** base `rc/v5`, stacked on **#124** @ `baf410f` → **#126** commit 0 (`d4b5fdc`) **merged in** @ `f97be20` (ordinary merge-forward; no rebase).

**Head:** `a8a1ae8a224d69c6b9099f25351ecd6ed1d4361b`

### Scope (row 32 only)
- Commit 0 (via #126 merge): `familyClamp` / `familyActiveBp` / family caps
- WIP 1–3 + harden: Present calm-gate + `session_end.present_active_s` / `present_lost_count`; Away offline; Broody `broodyBpEff`; `offline_grant.away_bp` (incl. eggs=0)
- **NOT** row 34 (`hatch_started` / `breed_*` / other breeds `session_end` — gen/breeds-telemetry). `sessionEndPresentFields()` is a separate `session_end` helper line. Does not touch #119 `paused_worker_s` / `all_paused_s`.

### Cites
- Spec **v0.2 rev 3.8.9** sha1 **ea922eb8** (BR-R12/R12b/R13/R14, E8/E9, BR-AC18/46/47/48/53)
- Telemetry errata **rev 15** sha1 **5e12a591** (V-2b `offline_grant.away_bp`)
- **`bc_broody_cap_bp` = 2000** (spec L368 / §5; family clamp before `broodyBpEff`)

### API
| Name | Notes |
|---|---|
| `familyClamp(s,b,family)` | `{rawBp,clampedBp,atCap}` |
| `familyActiveBp(s,b,family)` | shared clamp (effects) |
| `presentGateOpen(s,b)` | `k=0` → always open |
| `calmGateOpen(...)` | pure helper / BR-AC48 |
| `sessionEndPresentFields(s,b)` | row 32 `present_*` only |
| `offlineGrantV5(b, away_bp)` | `away_bp` breeds-on |
| `bc()` keys | `present_calm_w_s/k`, `lay_cap_bp_lt18`, `lay_cap_bp`, `lay_cap_farm`, `away_cap_bp`, `broody_cap_bp` |

### Trace table (AC / spec id → test file::name)
| Id | Test |
|---|---|
| §4.3 L365–368 | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`matches spec of record via bc() keys (no bc_ prefix)` |
| E9 | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`familyCapBp present: 700 below F18, 1500 from F18` |
| BR-AC18 / E8 | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`[BR-AC18][E8] 3 Present at 2★ (1575) at F24 → raw 1575, clamped 1500, atCap` |
| BR-AC18 | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`[BR-AC18] below cap: Leghorn 2★ alone (375) at F12 → not atCap` |
| BR-AC18 / E9 | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`[BR-AC18][E9] 975 bp at F17 clamps to 700; at F18 stays 975` |
| E8 Away/Broody | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`[E8] Away over 3000 clamps; Broody over 2000 clamps` |
| shared clamp | `tests/v5-breeds-family-caps.test.ts`::`familyActiveBp === familyClamp.clampedBp === clampFamilyBp(raw)` |
| BR-R12 | `tests/v5-breeds-present.test.ts`::`focused tick with settled Present adds prod × focusS × bp / 10000 eggs; no-focus adds none` |
| BR-BB2 | `tests/v5-breeds-present.test.ts`::`[BR-BB2] incomePerSec unchanged with Present slotted` |
| BR-AC18 | `tests/v5-breeds-present.test.ts`::`[BR-AC18] Present bp clamps at lay_cap` |

| BR-AC47 | `tests/v5-breeds-present.test.ts`::`[BR-AC47] gate reopens when oldest stamp ages out of the 10 s window` |

| BR-R13 | `tests/v5-breeds-away-broody.test.ts`::`awayBp sums settled Away breeds; 0 while settling or flag-off` |

| V-2b | `tests/v5-breeds-away-bp.test.ts`::`grantOffline with eggs>0 includes real away_bp` |
| V-2b flag-off | `tests/v5-breeds-away-bp.test.ts`::`flag-off: no away_bp and no emit on eggs=0` |

### Test plan
- [x] `tsc --noEmit`
- [x] `sync-economy --check`
- [x] focused: family-caps + present + away-broody + away-bp + hatch + state + F3 (**146 pass**)
- Hosted CI on push (no polling)
